description: Record one saved provider quote selection after the principal approves its exact provider, outcome and price. Validates the approval delegated to the named agent. The current provider mode returns a signed quote-selection receipt with funds_moved false. POST /api/sports-book-leg. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls over rolling 30 days. X-Wever-Wallet-Proof binds the exact JSON arguments to this API path. API access fees are separate from travel spending. Per-leg principal approval and delegated authority govern spending. Conditional escrow has a 300 USDC per-leg cap. Current sports-trip provider mode retains quotes and approvals; its receipts identify quote selection and withdrawal. Read /api/sports-trips-contract for schemas, provider availability, receipt verification and approval terms.
name: wever_sports-book-leg
title: Book a trip leg
